answer_1.quote: Since CRSs rely on the ability to understand and generate natural language conversations, capable approaches for CRSs have been built on pre‑trained language models ... We focus our evaluation of ChatGPT on its performance in the recommendation subtask, generating recommendation lists and explanations.
answer_1.outputs: recommendation lists, explanatory sentences, conversational responses

answer_2.quote: We use Recall@k to evaluate the recommendation subtask ... we also use a LLM‑based scorer to assess persuasiveness of explanations.

answer_3.quote: We propose an LLM‑based scorer that can automatically give the score through prompting ... we use the text‑davinci‑003 model as the scorer.

answer_4.quote: We first invite five annotators to play the role of the system and engage in interactions ... Two annotators judge the relevance degree of explanations ... another two annotators make pairwise evaluations of naturalness and usefulness.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to rate explanations for relevance, naturalness, usefulness, and persuasiveness based on predefined criteria.
